data.rationale: The proposal matches the true sequence (open Planned Work, type route in Search Routes, select it) and has the same route and date parameters. It adds date-picker steps, which the true workflow marks as "if needed", and it doesn't say how to pick the date. A browser automation could still be built from it, because the steps are concrete and both varying inputs are named as parameters.
